'''Rowen''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] aboard the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Sentinel (Victory-class)|''Sentinel'']]. At some point in his short career he embarrassed his [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. As punishment, Rowan was assigned to board and inspect commercial [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] approaching and departing [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]].
